description.value:
You've passed your 75th birthday and entered the final stage of the mecenaic life cycle. You've seen almost everything there is to see, and your steadying presence and serious demeanor is reassuring to those around you.

You're trained in Diplomacy. If you would automatically become trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the No Cause For Alarm skill feat.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
